comparisons.peer_summary: AMD's operating results vary seasonally, with historically higher net revenue in the second half of the year compared to the first half, although these trends may be impacted by market conditions and product transitions.
comparisons.comparison: Both NVIDIA and AMD disclose that their revenue historically exhibits seasonality with stronger performance in the second half of the fiscal year. NVIDIA specifically attributes this to desktop gaming products (target: 'Our desktop gaming products typically see stronger revenue in the second half of our fiscal year.'), while AMD states its net revenue is 'generally higher in the second half of the year than in the first half' (peer: 'Historically, our net revenue has been generally higher in the second half of the year than in the first half of the year'). Both companies also include caveats that these historical trends may not repeat or may be impacted by external factors (NVIDIA: 'Historical seasonality trends may not repeat.'; AMD: 'market conditions and product transitions could impact these trends.').
